difficulty_reason: The author turns a hypothetical fast randomized Kt algorithm into a symmetry-of-information inequality via reconstructive PRG hybrids. Exhaustively finding lexicographically first incompressible strings then produces a pair whose joint randomized description is too short. Full padding and promise handling extends the contradiction to infinitely-often gap algorithms.
